Harper (Growth): Quick sync 0-min demo + 30-min hands-on workshop, 3 launch posts, and a tiny credit timing A/B. Goal: lift 7-day activations (>=1k tokens). Anyone object?
Finn (Design): No objections. Two creative hooks: 'Build in an hour' vs 'Cut inference costs'. I'll mock hero cards for both.
Nia (Product): Workshop output = working endpoint + 3 persona prompt snippets. We'll bundle a starter prompt pack. Experiment: CREDIT_NOW vs CREDIT_DELAYED. Randomize at signup.
Omar (Eng): Implementation: add credit_arm field to signup payload (NOW|DELAYED), tag cohort=fieldlab-jul. If user hits >=1000 tokens in 7d, emit lead_event to growth-sales. Also gate routes if sales backlog > 20 leads.
form-bot: Form live -> 34 regs in 3h, source=org-tweet, CTR 3.2% :sparkles:
Harper (Growth): Draft social copy, edit freely:
Short A: "Ship an LLM feature fast. Join our Field Lab + get starter credits: https://redwood.ai/fieldlab"
Short B: "Lower inference costs, ship faster. Live Field Lab + prompt pack. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/fieldlab"
Finn (Design): A is punchy for X, B suits LinkedIn. I'll produce hero GIFs and a compact benchmark card comparing per-token cost + 95p latency. Need numbers from Omar.
Nia (Product): Hypothesis: CREDIT_NOW increases attendance; CREDIT_DELAYED increases post-event activation. We'll randomize evenly and track cohorts. Primary KPI = % registrants hitting >=1k tokens in 7d. Secondary = cost/activated-user.
Omar (Eng): I'll wire credit_arm, route rules, and provide 50/95/99 pctl latencies & per-token cost by EOD. Sample signup payload: {"cohort":"fieldlab-jul","credit_arm":"NOW|DELAYED"}.
Harper (Growth): Routing JSON draft:
{"source":"fieldlab_form","tags":["cohort:fieldlab-jul","launch:fieldlab-jul"],"route_to":"growth-sales","route_if":{"7d_tokens":">=1000"},"fallback":"nurture-sequence"}
Nia (Product): Add fallback nuance: if growth-sales queue > 20, route to automated high-intent nurture and send prompt pack email.
Finn (Design): I'll deliver two hero GIFs + benchmark card by tomorrow morning.
Omar (Eng): Routing and metrics wired by EOD; sharing infra numbers in this thread when ready.
Harper (Growth): Action items: Finn (creative), Nia (agenda & prompt pack), Omar (routing + infra numbers), Harper (ads + tracking). Dry run 24h before event. Thanks all :thumbsup:
